decision_rationale: The paper presents BioMedGPT as an open multimodal generative pre-trained transformer and describes large-scale pretraining plus alignment to biological modalities. The abstract also frames it as a foundation model for biomedicine with broad downstream QA applicability.
evidence_snippet: "open multimodal generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) for biomedicine"; "trained on enormous amounts of unlabelled data through self-supervised learning"; "aligns different biological modalities with natural language"; "foundation models"; "broad spectrum of tasks"
